solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Winger, smooth player

parts.note: to sand a surface is to smooth it
a piper is one who plays the pipes

explanation.surface: A footballer on the wing praised as a slick, skilful player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a footballer, but here it is simply a creature with wings.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandpiper is a wading bird, and any bird is a creature that flies on wings.

clue.text: Animal small, just right

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
to a T means exactly or just right

explanation.surface: A small animal that is exactly right.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoat is a small carnivorous mammal of the weasel family.

clue.text: Charge university set up in New York, void

indicators.note: the charge and university go in the New York abbreviation
in a down answer, set up means raised, so the letters read upwards

parts.note: to fill is to load or charge

explanation.surface: A university fee in New York is declared invalid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reverses FILL + U to ULLIF.
explanation.definitionFit: To void a contract is to cancel it, making it legally null.

clue.text: Drunk almost ending on floor, one laying it on thick

indicators.note: almost all of the word is used, so its last letter goes

parts.note: plastered is slang for drunk

indicators.note: the ending on a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A drunk nearly ends up on the floor, overdoing it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last D from PLASTERED.
explanation.definitionFit: A plasterer spreads thick plaster on walls, so literally lays it on thick.

clue.text: Artist's material somehow cheaper: aim to cover page

indicators.note: the rearranged letters cover the page, which goes inside them
the letters are put together in some unstated new way, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: An artist seeks a cheaper material to cover a page.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal scrambles the fodder into APIERMACHE, with 'to cover' wrapping the page letter; 'Artist's material' suggests paint, but this is for modelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Papier-mache is paper pulp and paste, used by artists to model objects.

clue.text: Headless reptile, fabulous monster

indicators.note: without its head, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: croc is short for crocodile, a reptile

explanation.surface: A decapitated reptile becomes a mythical beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend, as in the tales of Sinbad.

clue.text: Storage facility had a few jars knocked over

indicators.note: something knocked over is upended, so the word is read from the far end back

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily, so a person who had a few jars toped

explanation.surface: Someone at a warehouse had a few drinks and sent the jars flying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jars' are pints of beer in British slang; 'knocked over' turns TOPED round.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a warehouse or yard where goods or vehicles are kept until needed.

clue.text: Indian territory food seller mentioned?

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word is taken by how it sounds

parts.note: a deli, or delicatessen, sells food

explanation.surface: Is a food shop being referred to as Indian land?
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is a union territory of India containing the capital New Delhi.

clue.text: City getting disastrous coverage of display: topsy-turvy one, that is

parts.note: pomp is showy display

indicators.note: topsy-turvy means upside down, so in a down answer the letters run upwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A city's display gets awful press coverage that turns everything upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topsy-turvy' reverses I + IE to EII. The disastrous coverage was the volcanic ash of AD 79.
explanation.definitionFit: Pompeii was the Roman town buried by ash from Vesuvius, a disaster that covered it.

clue.text: Instrument I found in experiment, most troublesome

indicators.note: these pieces are found inside the experiment word

parts.note: a test is an experiment
a horn is a musical instrument

explanation.surface: A lab worker finds an instrument most troublesome in an experiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorny means prickly and difficult, so the superlative is the most problematic.

clue.text: Lighter work around shopping centre, this person recalled

indicators.note: the work abbreviation wraps around the other letters, so it is the outer piece

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so these words are taken in reverse

parts.note: a mall is a shopping centre
the setter refers to themself, giving I

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a job done near the local mall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' gives ILLAM and 'around' wraps it. 'Lighter' looks like a cigarette lighter or a comparative, but is a thing giving light.
explanation.definitionFit: An oil lamp is a source of light, so it is something that lights a room.

clue.text: See, with touring group, capital city

indicators.note: going on tour round something, so the group goes round the other piece

parts.note: a combo is a small band of musicians
lo is an old word meaning look or see

explanation.surface: A band takes in the sights on tour around a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'LO' is an archaic interjection meaning 'look!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Colombo is the largest city and commercial capital of Sri Lanka.

clue.text: Famous Dickensian turn of events

definitions.meaning: Oliver ..., the orphan in Dickens's novel of that name
an unexpected development in a story

explanation.surface: A celebrated plot development in a Dickens novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver Twist is Dickens's title character, and a twist is a sudden plot turn.

clue.text: Grasped by uncle, somehow, concept of ancient geometry

indicators.note: the concept is held within the other letters, so it goes inside them
the letters are put together in some unstated new way, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: an idea is a concept

explanation.surface: An uncle gets his head round an ancient geometrical idea.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal scrambles the relative to EUCLN, and 'Grasped by' places the concept within. The definition is adjectival: 'of ancient geometry'.
explanation.definitionFit: Euclid was the Greek mathematician whose Elements set out the classical geometry of the plane.

clue.text: Thinking in box, OK to score?

indicators.note: the score permission goes in the box word

parts.note: a crate is a box
in football, a player who is onside is allowed to score

explanation.surface: A footballer in the penalty box wonders if he's allowed to score.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' looks like the penalty area but is a CRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Considerate means thoughtful of others, and thinking of others is the sense here.

clue.text: Uninspiring legend or story ends

indicators.note: the ends of these three words are their final letters, which are taken

explanation.surface: A dull legend or tale fizzles out at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry writing is dull and lacking interest, so it fails to inspire.

clue.text: Slowly coming to understand unkind remark, gibe ultimately hurt

parts.note: a dig is a snide remark

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so the last letter is taken

parts.note: to sting is to hurt

explanation.surface: Taking time to absorb an unkind remark, finally hurt by the jibe.
explanation.definitionFit: Digesting news means absorbing and gradually grasping it, as the body slowly absorbs food.

clue.text: Mercurial premier defending country in old political system

indicators.note: the rearranged letters surround and so protect the country, which goes inside
mercurial means volatile and changeable, so the letters change their order

parts.note: Oman is a country in Arabia

explanation.surface: A volatile prime minister standing up for his nation in an old regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mercurial' gives R + EMPIRE, and 'defending' means surrounding the country. 'Mercurial' could suggest the planet or the god, but only signals change.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman Empire was the ancient state ruled by emperors from Rome.

clue.text: Young men following game wasted a lot of money

indicators.note: the young men come after the other piece
something wasted is ruined, so the letters are wrecked into a new order

parts.note: bucks are lively young men

explanation.surface: Young men lose a fortune after a game, wasted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasted' rearranges GAME to MEGA.
explanation.definitionFit: Megabucks is slang for a huge sum of money.

clue.text: Start — to make an omelette?

definitions.meaning: eggs must be cracked to make an omelette, a literal reading

explanation.surface: Begin the job, perhaps by breaking eggs for an omelette.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to begin promptly; literally, cracking eggs is what an omelette needs.

clue.text: Cord securing lamb cooked in meat dish

indicators.note: the cord holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a tie is a cord used to bind something

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are prepared in a new way

explanation.surface: String tied round lamb as it cooks in a meat dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' gives IMBAL, and 'securing' means the cord goes round it; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A timbale is a savoury dish baked in a drum-shaped mould, often of meat or fish.

clue.text: Site in Angkor in view: a temple

indicators.note: the answer lies within the following words, running across their breaks

explanation.surface: A temple seen from a viewpoint at Angkor.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits inside 'vieW A Temple'.
explanation.definitionFit: Angkor Wat is the great Cambodian temple complex at the site of Angkor.

clue.text: Capital in Washington, I note, a US city

indicators.note: the capital of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a chit is a short note

explanation.surface: A note written in the US capital about another American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like Washington the capital city, but is its capital letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Wichita is the largest city in Kansas, in the United States.

clue.text: Understand about part of speech I'm to write about in note

indicators.note: the first word goes about, or around, the remaining letters

parts.note: to see is to understand

indicators.note: the part of speech and I'm are turned about, so they read backwards

parts.note: a verb is a part of speech

explanation.surface: A grammar student grasps a part of speech to write about.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'about' reverses the grammatical pieces to MIBREV, the first 'about' wraps it; 'to write' is a link. 'Note' is musical, not a written note.
explanation.definitionFit: A semibreve is a musical whole note, held for four beats.

clue.text: Good egg — that won't float on water!

definitions.meaning: a ... sinks, so it does not float

explanation.surface: A good egg is one that won't float, the old freshness test.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a brick praises them as dependable; a literal brick sinks like a stone.

clue.text: Artist saved flesh?

definitions.meaning: Francis ... was an Irish-born British painter
to save one's ... is to escape harm, and ... is cured, or preserved, meat

explanation.surface: A painter whose figures look like rescued flesh.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Bacon painted distorted figures; bacon is cured pork, and the idiom 'save your bacon' means escape harm.

clue.text: Relative regularly on site, a chef

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A relative is regularly on site as a chef.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the second, fourth and every other letter of 'on site, a chef'.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is a family relation, the daughter of one's brother or sister.

clue.text: Think of a number in the seventies

definitions.meaning: to form a picture in the mind
John Lennon's 1971 hit song, a musical number

explanation.surface: Pick a number between seventy and seventy-nine.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine something is to picture it in the mind; Lennon's song Imagine came out in 1971.

clue.text: Coming up, check out festival

indicators.note: in a down answer, coming up means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: to check out is slang for to die

explanation.surface: Checking out as a festival approaches.
explanation.definitionFit: Eid is a Muslim festival, such as Eid al-Fitr at the end of Ramadan.

clue.text: Record store, busy place on Circle Line

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece set on another follows it

parts.note: an arc is a curved line, part of a circle
a hive of activity is a busy place

explanation.surface: A busy record shop on the London Underground's Circle Line.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle Line is a London Underground route, but here it is an ARC.
explanation.definitionFit: An archive is a place where historical records and documents are stored.

clue.text: European king attending match, hiding crown

indicators.note: attending means accompanying, so the king joins the other piece
the top or crown of the word is hidden away, so its first letter goes

parts.note: to agree is to match
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A European monarch at a match, without his crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hiding crown' removes the first letter of AGREE, leaving GREE.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek is a person from Greece, a European country.

clue.text: Return of expedition, walk somewhere far, far away

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so the word is written backwards

parts.note: expedition can mean promptness or speed
to pace is to walk

explanation.surface: The return leg of an expedition, a walk to a remote place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return of' gives DEEPS. 'expedition' means haste here, not a journey, despite the travel surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep space is the region of the universe far beyond Earth and its moon.
